abstract: Data analysis which were performed for HORIZON project MARCO-BOLO Deliverable D3.3 of Task 3.3.
description: Data analysis which were performed for HORIZON project MARCO-BOLO Deliverable D3.3 of Task 3.3: Calculated diversity and ploted as non-metric multidimensional scaling (Nmds), Ploted species distribution according to distance in the river-to-sea continuum, Calculated diversity Indices (Shannon, Simpson, Richness, Evenness) and ploted them according to distance in the river-to-sea continuum, Tested correlations of diversity indices with environmental variables, Calculated and ploted redundancy analysis (RDA).
name: T3.3: Analyse the QCd and formatted data
